content2.content: Notifications serve various purposes depending on the app type.

content4.content: Social media apps use them to notify users of likes, comments, and messages to bring them back to the app.

content6.content: E-commerce and banking apps use them for order updates, payment confirmations, and security alerts.

content8.content: Productivity and health apps use them to remind users of tasks, events, or habits.

content10.content: Identify the key value proposition of your notifications to ensure they are welcome, not annoying.
